phase_name: Upsert semantics and version/generated stamp in the index merge

objectives.description: Convert append_index_entries to upsert semantics, stamp version/generated, update stale validate-context-index.sh comment

deviations.description: Cross-extension path collision found (core/lean sharing 3 contracts/*.md paths as intentional lean4 overrides) and a within-file cslib duplicate; neither was fixed, both documented as findings
deviations.reason: The 3 core/lean collisions are legitimate intentional overrides, not bugs -- deleting either side would destroy real content and violates the plan's non-goal against rewriting context files. Resolving load-order-independent override priority is a materially separate feature, out of scope for an upsert-semantics change. Documented as a known dormant risk in the function's LuaDoc instead. The cslib within-file duplicate is unrelated to cross-extension merge collisions and out of scope.
deviations.annotation: documented in LuaDoc comment on M.append_index_entries and in the plan's Phase 4 task checklist
